chunks: And indeed, Elias is one of the apostles.

key_terms.إِلْيَاسَ: Ilyas (Elias), a prophet mentioned in the Quran
key_terms.الْمُرْسَلِينَ: The messengers or apostles sent by God

ai.seo_question: Who is Ilyas in the Quran and what is his status among the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse affirms Ilyas’s status among the *Murasal* (prophets sent to specific communities), often linking him to the tribe of Benjamin and his mission to combat the idolatry of Baal. This brief mention underscores the continuity of divine guidance, positioning him within the broader narrative of prophets who called their people back to monotheism before the advent of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
